entities.summary: Pepita Seth is a British-born Indian writer and photographer. Her photography features the temple arts and rituals of Kerala and the captive elephant, Guruvayur Keshavan. The Government of India honoured her, in 2012, with the Padma Shri, the fourth highest civilian award, for her services to the field of art and culture.
